page.layout: One column of running text, printed in a single block. Marginal references in the left margin, beside the lines "traditur", "Ita mulier", "lophylis" and "victores". Running head at top. No text below the column.

main_text.p: destituti præsidio, subjecti Asilophylis [?] per XL. captivitatis annos pœnas perfidiæ pe-penderunt. Ea rempestate Samson natusIud. 13. traditur. Hujus mater, diu sterilis, angeli[?] vidit, diȼumque ci est, vino & sicera atq; immundis abstineret, fore uti puerum e- deceret libertatis vindicē & hostium ultos Samson. rem. Ita mulier enixa puerum Sãson no- mē ci indidit, Is intonto capite mitæ vir- tutis suisse traditur adeo ut leonem in via obvium manu discerperet uxorem ex Al- lophylis habuit, quæ cum absente viro in alterius matrimonium convenisset, dolo- re ereptæ coniugis pernicieni genti mo- litus est fretus Domino & viribus, palam Iud. 14. vi&tores clade afficiebat. CCC. siquidem vulpibus captis, ardentes lampades ea- rum illigavit caudis, atq; eas agris hosti- um immisit. At tum forte maturis messis bus facile incendium tuit, vinearq; & olive- varum arbores exustæ. Grandi Allopylo- rum exitio abreptæ uxoris injuriam ultus videbatur. Quo dolore Alloph[?]ylis permo- ti mulierem, tanti mali causam cum do- mo & patre incendio confumpserunt. Sed Samson parum se vindicatum ratus, urgere omnibus incommodis profanam gentem

page.notes: Marginal references read "Iud. 13.", "Samson. rem." (the second word uncertain), "Iud. 14." and "Iud. 15." (the last is partly faint). Words marked [?] are doubtful: "Asilophylis", "angeli", "Alloph", "pe-" at the line end before "penderunt". Line breaks at "pe-", "ea-", "hosti-" and "messis" are reflowed into the running text. Several s and f forms are difficult at the scan's edge; the text was read as s. The page number at the top left is faint.
